column7: BulkRenameSecrets decided the bulk rename per entry only (enforceSecretWriteGate), so a project viewer holding a per-secret ACL write could rename those secrets through a direct core call while REST refused them (sibling of #4161 row 25). Core now calls requireScopedGate(secrets.write, project) after the request-shape checks and before any secret is read; a refusal renames, reports and audits nothing, dry run included. Defence in depth: REST already refused and there is no gRPC method.
